title: Dimethylglycine accelerate atherosclerosis by mediating macrophages ferroptosis via NRF2 pathway suppression.
authors: Zhang, Ruixue; Gu, Qishuo; Qu, Sheng; Chen, Yuwu; Lu, Chengbo; Zhao, Guangyang; Zhao, Weiqing; Chen, Weida; Liu, Yu; Zhou, Xin; Dong, Tianwei; Yang, Guangyuan
one_liner_zh: 该文研究DMG通过结合NRF2抑制其核转位促进巨噬细胞铁死亡加速动脉粥样硬化，虽含分子对接但核心是疾病机制而非TF-DNA互作建模，方法上无AI或物理模拟创新，仅边缘相关。
abstract: BACKGROUND: Dimethylglycine (DMG) has been shown to be highly correlated with coronary heart disease (CHD), whose pathological basic is atherosclerosis (AS). Macrophage ferroptosis is the crucial pathological events in AS progression, but the underlying mechanism is unclear. Hence, we conducted a series of studies to elucidate the specific effects and mechanism of DMG on macrophages in the progression of AS. METHOD: A case-control study was conducted on patients with CHD to evaluate the levels of DMG. Additionally, a prospective cohort study was performed to assess the association between baseline serum DMG levels and the incidence of major adverse cardiovascular events (MACE). Single-cell RNA sequencing (scRNA-seq) and proteomics analyses were conducted on the aortas of high-fat diet-fed ApoE knockout (ApoE(KO)) mice administered with or without DMG. THP-1 were exposed to DMG in vitro to investigate potential underlying mechanisms. RESULTS: High level DMG level was associated with higher MACE rate in patients with ST-segment elevation myocardial infarction (STEMI). DMG administration significantly decreased the glutathione Peroxidase 4 (GPX4)/solute carrier family 7 member 11 (xCT) expression of macrophages of aortas in ApoE(KO) mice. Mechanically, Mechanistically, DMG bound to the Ile559 (I559) site of NRF2 (identified by molecular docking and validated by site-directed mutagenesis), inhibited NRF2 nuclear translocation and its promoter enrichment on GPX4/xCT, which was reversed by TBHQ. and mutation of the I559 site (I559S) significantly inhibited the DMG-induced ferroptosis of macrophages. In vivo study demonstrated that the administration of DMG via gavage markedly exacerbated atherosclerotic lesion severity, exhibiting elevated the extent of aortic lipid peroxidation, and increased ferroptosis levels in macrophages, which were ameliorated by TBHQ administration. CONCLUSIONS: DMG inhibits NRF2 nuclear translocation mainly by binding to the I559 site of NRF2 (identified by molecular docking and validated by site-directed mutagenesis), thereby reducing GPX4/xCT expression and promoting macrophage ferroptosis to accelerate AS. Targeting macrophages ferroptosis may serve as a potential intervention strategy for CHD patients with high DMG.
abstract_zh: 背景：二甲基甘氨酸（DMG）已被证明与冠状动脉心脏病（CHD）高度相关，其病理基础是动脉粥样硬化（AS）。巨噬细胞铁死亡是AS进展中的关键病理事件，但其潜在机制尚不清楚。因此，我们开展了一系列研究，以阐明DMG在AS进展中对巨噬细胞的具体影响及机制。方法：对CHD患者进行了一项病例对照研究，以评估DMG水平。此外，进行了一项前瞻性队列研究，以评估基线血清DMG水平与主要不良心血管事件（MACE）发生率之间的关联。对高脂饮食喂养的ApoE敲除（ApoE(KO)）小鼠（给予或不给予DMG）的主动脉进行了单细胞RNA测序（scRNA-seq）和蛋白质组学分析。体外实验中，将THP-1细胞暴露于DMG，以探究潜在机制。结果：在ST段抬高型心肌梗死（STEMI）患者中，高DMG水平与较高的MACE发生率相关。DMG给药显著降低了ApoE(KO)小鼠主动脉巨噬细胞中谷胱甘肽过氧化物酶4（GPX4）/溶质载体家族7成员11（xCT）的表达。机制上，DMG结合NRF2的Ile559（I559）位点（通过分子对接鉴定，并经定点突变验证），抑制NRF2核转位及其在GPX4/xCT上的启动子富集，这一效应可被TBHQ逆转。I559位点突变（I559S）显著抑制了DMG诱导的巨噬细胞铁死亡。体内研究表明，通过灌胃给予DMG显著加重了动脉粥样硬化病变严重程度，表现为主动脉脂质过氧化程度升高，巨噬细胞铁死亡水平增加，而这些效应通过TBHQ给药得到改善。结论：DMG主要通过结合NRF2的I559位点（通过分子对接鉴定，并经定点突变验证）抑制NRF2核转位，从而降低GPX4/xCT表达并促进巨噬细胞铁死亡，加速AS进展。靶向巨噬细胞铁死亡可能成为高DMG水平CHD患者的潜在干预策略。
